name: Propeller Cap
description: A rainbow beanie with a propeller that never stops spinning. Faster when you sprint.

name: Royal Crown
description: Solid gold, glowing gems. For the ruler of the lobby.

name: Angel Halo
description: A warm glowing halo that floats and drifts above your head.

name: Gentleman Top Hat
description: Tall, black and very proper, with a crimson band.

name: Pixel Shades
description: Deal with it. Pixel-perfect black shades.

name: Study Glasses
description: Thick tortoiseshell frames with real glass lenses.

name: Cyber Visor
description: A neon HUD visor with a scanner that sweeps side to side.

name: Angel Wings
description: Soft white feathered wings that gently flap, and beat harder when you run.

name: Dragon Wings
description: Leathery wings with bony spines and claws. Slow, powerful beats.

name: Explorer Backpack
description: A leather adventuring pack with a bedroll. It bounces as you walk.

name: Rocket Jetpack
description: Twin-tank jetpack with flickering rocket flames. Liftoff not included.

name: Street Sneakers
description: Fresh red kicks with white soles and laces.

name: Rocket Boots
description: Chrome boots with glowing heel thrusters that sputter as you move.
